author: blekek.k
title: Looking for illustrators for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws: Anime / manga style illustrations; Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration; Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork; Semi-realistic illustrations; and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Follow-up (09/21/26): Thanks you guys for reaching out. I'll be checking your portfolio. For the ones who haven't sent in their portfolio, you can provide a link where I can see your previous works. Contact: comment on the post or DM @blekek.k.

author: Veli Raiya
title: Seeking fantasy map designer and character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn't have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you're a fantasy author recommending someone you've personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. Character art: more realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon; lighter fantasy book; open to styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Portraits for now, more if the style fits the series. Map: detailed and immersive classic fantasy-map feel, open stylistically. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites.

author: Temmycreative
title: Paid vector illustrator for Halloween apparel
content: Looking for a vector illustrator (Paid). Need an illustrator who can create an original 80s-90s Goosebumps-inspired Halloween design for a hoodie/T-shirt. Requirements: one skeleton as the main character; punk/rock retro horror vibe; clean vector for screen printing (AI/SVG/EPS); large back print (13 in x 16 in); neon green, purple and orange palette; original artwork only (no tracing existing designs). Please reply with your portfolio, turnaround time, and price. Contact: reply on the post or DM @temmycreative_.
